values: Reconciled with production OLTP v2.200109 and OLAP v1.000175 on 2026-09-02. OLAP Borrowers now includes eleven borrower-value/stability matrix helpers, all exposed through Reporting Borrowers for the new Looker Studio Borrowers Analysis bubble chart. The chart uses 30-day realized-profit share, a dynamically normalized stability score, outstanding principal bubble size, and active-borrower filtering. The current OLAP schema also retains Projected Monthly Profit Contribution and the pre-existing Hidden Flag; Hidden Flag is not used by OLAP reporting filters. Manual dashboard acceptance remains pending.

Borrowers[Projected Monthly Profit Contribution] and the eleven Matrix* helpers are OLAP-only. Borrowers[Hidden Flag] is loaded in both apps, but only the OLTP Visible Borrowers slice uses it as a filter. Loans[Daily Installment Base Principal] and the four Calendar schedule VCs remain OLAP-only reporting helpers. Charges[Ref Loans] is OLTP-required; the OLAP Required flag was not changed or re-verified.
